text: « Inlinear regression, by (the intercept) and b (the slope) are the parameters you adjust to fit the data. «Minimizing the sum of squared errors L (bo, bx) by setting these partial derivatives to zero leads to a closed-form solution (the normal equations) for by and by. « This principle generalizes to more complex models where you might have many parameters and have to rely on numerical optimization methods (like gradient descent) when no closed-form solution exists.
